title: Blade Runner
lede: Ridley Scott’s 1982 film set in a rain-soaked Los Angeles of 2019, whose dark, neon-lit, high-tech but decaying city became the visual model for cyberpunk.
summary: The founding image of the cyberpunk city: rain, neon, giant advertising, and noir darkness. Ridley Scott, with Syd Mead as concept artist, 1982.

creator.name: Ridley Scott (director); Syd Mead (concept artist); Lawrence G. Paull (production designer); Jordan Cronenweth (cinematographer)

evidence.note: Based on the Wikipedia article, read as wikitext on 2026-10-02. No image of the film was inspected for this record.

styles.note: The style record names Blade Runner as one of the two works that set the look of cyberpunk. Wikipedia calls it “a foundational work of the cyberpunk genre”.

context: Wikipedia: “Hailed for its production design depicting a high-tech but decaying future, the film is often regarded as both a leading example of neo-noir cinema and a foundational work of the cyberpunk genre.” [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blade_Runner).

Scott used Edward Hopper’s *Nighthawks* and the French comics magazine *Métal Hurlant* as mood sources, and drew on the landscape of “Hong Kong on a very bad day”. He hired Syd Mead as concept artist. Production designer Lawrence G. Paull and art director David Snyder realized Scott’s and Mead’s sketches. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blade_Runner).

Wikipedia notes that the film’s look, “in particular its overall darkness, preponderance of neon lights and opaque visuals”, made it a popular reference point for video games. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blade_Runner).
interpretation: The film fixed the core of the style’s imagery: night, rain, neon, and advertising on a scale that dwarfs people. Most later works quote it, including [Cyberpunk 2077](ref:cyberpunk-2077-video-game-2020).
Its link to film noir explains why the style is dark and lit by small, hard sources instead of daylight.
borrow: Keep most of the frame dark and let a few signs, screens, or advertisements carry all the light.
Pair high-tech elements with signs of wear and decay so that the future looks used.
next: Find an openly licensed or museum-documented still, or a production design drawing, that can be inspected, and upgrade the evidence level.

rights.statement: No image is stored. The film, its posters, and its stills are in copyright. This record does not name the rights holders.
